patches.name: Batch transcribe
patches.description: Shows Transcribe when several recordings are selected and transcribes them one after another, in list order. Recordings that can't be transcribed are skipped, and recordings can be added while others are still transcribing. Queued recordings show as waiting, a failed recording does not interrupt the batch, a notification shows the batch's progress and can cancel it, and a summary is shown when the batch ends.

patches.name: Import any audio files
patches.description: Imports audio files of any format in the Recordings folder and .oga files anywhere, including files not recorded by this app, and shows them in All recordings. .m4a files there are treated as recorded by this app even without its metadata, and transcription and AI features work on all formats except .amr and .3ga. Adds a setting for additional folders to import, each shown in the recordings list menu.
